justifications.durability: the new case at tests/test_a_worker_on_another_host_refuses_a_relaunch.py:363 reddens at 1ba776d856 (1 failed, 12 passed), but dropping require_run_id at reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:2158 reddens no test, so the retired receipt's strictness is unguarded.
justifications.evidence: baseline-arm.log and after-arm.log carry revision, command and a bare EXIT= line whose figures I reproduced at head, but the fragment's neighbours claim at docs/evidence/fragments/a-run-has-one-live-worker/a-worker-on-another-host-refuses-a-relaunch.html:36 cites a head arm whose log header names fc13619cea plus uncommitted work.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:2155-2156 keeps the file's function-local cross-module import idiom and the new keyword and docstring carry no plan, ticket or author identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:2228 and :2158 free an off-host launch only on a receipt the owner reads with require_run_id, and 37,282 of 37,282 receipts on disk carry this run's own run_id, so no genuinely ended launch is withheld.
justifications.reuse: the change deletes the forked reader and extends the existing owner at reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py:1499 with a receipt name and a strict reading, and a search for other exit-receipt readers in reckon/crew found only that owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: every hunk in git diff 1ba776d856..af3da92f84 lies in the four paths the round declares, and the write_scope_extension note covers recovery_liveness.py honestly.
